title: Ends at Midnight (Again)

pre.en: How long has the latest "last chance" offer been running?
pre.zh: 最新这个「最后机会」的优惠已经搞了多久？

intro: 这是布莱顿的自由撰稿人 Lucy 录的一段口播，讲她怎么一次次被「午夜截止」的倒计时骗。读的时候留意 so … that 和 such … that：so urgent that、such good tricks that、so popular that——「太…以至于…」，so 后面跟形容词或副词，such 后面跟名词。

sentences.en: So, last November, at 11:58 pm, I bought a blender I didn't need.
sentences.zh: 去年十一月，晚上 11 点 58 分，我买了一台根本用不着的搅拌机。

sentences.en: The website said £90 instead of £150.
sentences.zh: 网站上写着原价 150 英镑，现价 90 英镑。

sentences.en: And a big red clock was counting down the seconds to midnight.
sentences.zh: 页面上一个醒目的大红倒计时，一秒一秒地倒数到午夜。

sentences.en: The offer looked so urgent that I paid without reading a single review.
sentences.zh: 那个优惠看着十万火急，我连一条评价都没看就付了钱。

sentences.en: The next morning, I checked again.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上我再去看。

sentences.en: It was still £90 — with a brand-new clock.
sentences.zh: 还是 90 英镑——配上了一个崭新的倒计时。

sentences.en: Now, I'm a freelance writer in Brighton, and I like to think I'm a careful shopper.
sentences.zh: 说起来，我是布莱顿的自由撰稿人，一直觉得自己买东西挺精明的。

sentences.en: I'll happily spend twenty minutes tracking down a discount code for a £4 candle.
sentences.zh: 为了一根 4 英镑的蜡烛，我能乐呵呵地花二十分钟去找折扣码。

sentences.en: But countdown clocks are such good tricks that even I keep falling for them.
sentences.zh: 可倒计时这一招实在太高明了，连我都一次次上当。

sentences.en: And the excitement wears off so quickly that sometimes I forget what I've ordered.
sentences.zh: 而且那股兴奋劲儿过得飞快，有时候我连自己下单买了什么都忘了。

sentences.en: So these days, I've got a few rules.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，我给自己定了几条规矩。

sentences.en: I only sign up for an offer if I'd happily buy the thing at full price.
sentences.zh: 原价我也乐意买的东西，我才去抢它的优惠。

sentences.en: Before I spend more than £30, I shop around for a week.
sentences.zh: 超过 30 英镑的东西，我先货比三家，看上一个星期再说。

sentences.en: And I pay no attention to "only 2 left in stock".
sentences.zh: 还有，「库存仅剩 2 件」这种话，我一概不理。

sentences.en: Last month, my sister brought me along to a sale in Hove.
sentences.zh: 上个月，我妹妹拉我去霍夫逛一场促销。

sentences.en: One pair of boots there was so popular that it had "only 2 left" for six days.
sentences.zh: 有双靴子「抢手」到连着六天都「只剩 2 双」。

sentences.en: Honestly, if something looks too good to be true, it usually is.
sentences.zh: 说真的，一样东西要是好得不像真的，那它多半就不是真的。

sentences.en: My partner says I go on about this too much, and he's probably right.
sentences.zh: 我家那位说我在这件事上唠叨个没完，他大概说得没错。

sentences.en: But I can't stand being told what to do by a clock.
sentences.zh: 可我就是受不了被一个钟指挥来指挥去。

sentences.en: Since January, I've even got back into writing shopping lists on paper.
sentences.zh: 从一月起，我甚至又开始在纸上写购物清单了。

sentences.en: If I had a pound for every "last chance" I've seen, I'd be rich enough to buy that blender at full price.
sentences.zh: 要是每看到一个「最后机会」就能拿一英镑，我早就有钱按原价买下那台搅拌机了。

sentences.en: Anyway, as I'm recording this, my phone's just buzzed.
sentences.zh: 对了，就在我录这段的时候，手机刚震了一下。

sentences.en: It's an email: "Last chance, Lucy! 70% off — ends at midnight."
sentences.zh: 是封邮件：「最后机会，Lucy！三折——今晚午夜截止。」

sentences.en: It's been ending at midnight since March.
sentences.zh: 它从三月起就一直在「今晚午夜截止」了。

cards.note: 动词 blend 是「混合、搅拌」。
名词 urgency；urgent email 是「急件」。
比 new 语气强，强调「全新、没用过」。
做自由职业的人是 freelancer。
to find something or someone after searching for a long time
discount code 是网购用的折扣码。
动词短语是 count down：count down the seconds。

cards.zh: 上（某种花招）的当；信以为真
cards.note: to be tricked into believing something that is not true
cards.tip: fall for sb 是「爱上某人」，看后面接的是人还是花招；fall 的过去式是 fell。
cards.example: Don't fall for those emails that say you've won a prize.

cards.note: 形容词 excited（人感到兴奋）、exciting（让人兴奋的）。
to gradually stop having an effect
cards.tip: 主语是感觉、药效、新鲜感：The novelty wears off.
cards.example: The coffee wore off by eleven, and I was tired again.

cards.zh: 报名参加；注册（某项服务）
cards.note: to agree to take part in something or to start using a service, usually by giving your details
cards.tip: 后面接名词用 for，接动词用 to do：sign up to do a course；名词 sign-up 带连字符。
cards.example: I signed up for a free trial and forgot to cancel it.

cards.note: for the normal price, without any money taken off
cards.tip: 介词用 at；同样的还有 at half price（半价）、at a discount（打折）。
cards.example: I never buy books at full price.

cards.note: to compare the prices of something in different shops before you buy it
cards.tip: 不及物，后面要说买什么用 for：shop around for a new phone。
cards.example: It's worth shopping around for car insurance.

cards.note: to watch, listen to or think about something carefully
available in a shop and ready to buy
cards.tip: 反义是 out of stock（缺货）；stock 在这里不加冠词。
cards.example: Do you have this jacket in stock in a medium?

cards.note: to take someone or something with you when you go somewhere

cards.zh: 好得令人难以置信（多半有诈）
cards.note: so good that you think there must be a problem with it
cards.tip: 常跟在 look / sound / seem 后面；俗话说全了是 If it looks too good to be true, it probably is。
cards.example: A two-bedroom flat in central London for £800 a month? It sounds too good to be true.

cards.note: to talk about something for a long time, often in a way that is boring for other people
to dislike someone or something very much
cards.tip: 后面接名词或 doing：can't stand waiting；比 don't like 语气重得多。
cards.example: I can't stand people who talk during films.

cards.zh: 重新开始（做一件停了一阵的事）
cards.note: to start doing an activity again after a break
cards.tip: 后面接名词或 doing；英式的过去分词是 got。
cards.example: I'm trying to get back into reading before bed.
